summary: Swept 10 frontend targets. Added 7 new owner test files (http, 3 mutation hooks, useTodosQuery, useTodosBusy, useTodoFilters) and extended the 3 existing ones (api/todos, utils/todos, useNotice). The full frontend suite passes (82 tests, 21 files) and the frontend typecheck passes. Two suspected bugs in lib/http.ts are reported and not pinned.

targets.reason: The owner test covered only list and create; update and remove were untested. Coverage is now 100%.
behaviours: update sends only the changed fields as a PATCH body, omitting undefined ones
update from a full task never sends read-only fields
remove sends DELETE to /todos/{id}

targets.reason: No owner test existed; the todos API test mocks this module. Coverage is 100%. The two suspected bugs are left untested.
behaviours: requests go under /api with a JSON Content-Type and the parsed body is returned
caller headers given as a plain object override the defaults

an aborted request rethrows the original error

findings.detail: Caller headers are merged by spreading init.headers into a plain object. A Headers instance (or an array of tuples) spreads to nothing, so the caller's headers are silently dropped and only Content-Type is sent. Expected: caller headers are kept in any HeadersInit form. Not tested.

A 2xx response with a non-JSON body makes response.json() reject with a raw SyntaxError, whose parser message could reach the UI. Expected: a user-facing error like the other failure paths. Not tested.
